description: This file implements the RefRadioIms class methods for handling IMS radio responses in Android, including setting call info, updating registration, starting/stopping traffic, and other IMS-related operations.

classes.name: RefRadioIms
classes.description: Class implementing IMS radio response handling methods.

methods.name: setSrvccCallInfo
methods.description: Sets the SRVCC call information response.

methods.name: startImsTraffic
methods.description: Starts IMS traffic with specified parameters.

methods.name: triggerEpsFallback
methods.description: Triggers EPS fallback with a specified reason.

methods.name: sendAnbrQuery
methods.description: Sends an ANBR query with media type, direction, and bitrate.

methods.name: updateImsCallStatus
methods.description: Updates IMS call status with a list of current calls.
